personajes.en: Sun-darkened mestizo man, weathered face, thick gray mustache, wide-brimmed straw llanero hat worn daily, light shirt, dark trousers rolled at the ankle, worn leather alpargatas, holding a coiled rope.

Mestiza woman with sunburnt bronze skin, black hair in a low ponytail under a faded cap, long-sleeved plaid shirt, jeans, rubber boots, damp mud stains, holding a small bag of rice seed against green paddy fields.

Slim young mestizo man, short black hair, light stubble, full-face helmet under one arm, bright reflective vest over a casual T-shirt, jeans, sneakers, motorcycle gloves tucked in his belt, phone in hand.

personajes.oficio: Vendedora en galería y plaza de mercado
personajes.en: Mestiza woman, warm brown skin, curly dark hair pulled back, colorful but plain blouse, capri pants, sandals, plastic coin purse at hand, standing behind crates of plantains and cassava, money pouch across shoulder.

Young Sikuani woman, straight dark hair with straight-cut fringe, calm deep brown eyes, simple white T-shirt, jeans, worn sneakers, woven bag with a laptop and school notebook slung across her body, smartphone in hand.

Brown-skinned mestizo man, broad shoulders, cropped black hair, cement-dusted yellow safety helmet, sleeveless undershirt, worn jeans, scuffed work boots, dirty work gloves, carrying a bucket of wet concrete.

personajes.oficio: Enfermera de puesto de salud rural
personajes.en: Mestiza woman with indigenous features, hair in a practical bun, light blue medical uniform trousers and printed scrub top, white sneakers, stethoscope around neck, laminated vaccination schedule clipboard, reading glasses on a cord.

Elderly mestizo man, deeply wrinkled weathered skin, white combed-back hair, old straw hat, pressed guayabera-style light shirt, khaki trousers, clean sandals, walking slowly with a wooden cane and reading newspaper folded under one arm.
